Note that the measure of the exterior angle at $B$ is ${180}^{∘}-(4x+{18}^{∘})={162}^{∘}-4x.$

Since the sum of the exterior angles of a polygon is ${360}^{∘}$, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}(5x+{15}^{∘})+({162}^{∘}-4x)+(4x-{2}^{∘})+(3x+{1}^{∘}) & ={360}^{∘} \\ 8x+{176}^{∘} & ={360}^{∘} \\ 8x & ={184}^{∘} \\ x & ={23}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the measure of the exterior angle of $∠C$ equals

$$
\begin{aligned}4x-{2}^{∘} & =4({23}^{∘})-{2}^{∘} \\  & ={92}^{∘}-{2}^{∘} \\  & ={90}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
